title: Microsoft 365 admin center: cross-tenant orchestrated migration of user and shared data
summary: Hold: the create-job control omits settings required for mailbox migration and incorrectly suggests that creating a job also validates and starts it. The default and licensing fields overstate what is known about the planned admin centre experience, and the cutover description omits the requirement for mailbox synchronization to finish first.

claims.quote: Microsoft 365 admin center: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration; allows customers to move their Microsoft 365 data from one Microsoft tenant to another.

claims.claim: The roadmap's SDM scope includes Microsoft 365 Groups, SharePoint sites, group mailboxes, and teams and channels.
claims.quote: SDM includes the ability to move M365 Groups, SharePoint Sites, Group Mailboxes, and teams and channels.

claims.quote: Fix any issues and call validate again on the same batch. Repeat until the status is ValidatePassed.

claims.quote: Validation results expire after seven days. If more than seven days pass between validation passing and calling migrate, you must revalidate the batch before migration can proceed.

claims.quote: If a migration completes with errors (Status: CompletedWithErrors) or fails (Status: Failed), you can call migrate again on the same batch to retry.

claims.claim: Source MailUsers may be removed when business processes allow.
claims.quote: When business processes allow, the source tenant can remove the source MailUser or convert them to a mail contact.

claims.claim: Delegated create-job callers need one of the two named built-in roles, with no custom-role alternative mentioned.
claims.quote: the signed-in user must be assigned a supported Microsoft Entra role or a custom role that grants the permissions required for this operation.
claims.fix: Replace the note with 'Needs CrossTenantContentMigration.ReadWrite.All; for delegated creation, the caller needs Microsoft 365 Migration Administrator, Global Administrator, or a custom role granting the required permissions, on the target tenant.' Mirror the note in the rendered table; keep the body's separate description of the running-migration instructions.

claims.claim: The listed POST v1.0 create-job request supplies the settings needed to create the described migration batch.
claims.quote: exchangeSettings | exchangeOnlineCrossTenantMigrationSettings | Settings for Exchange Online migrations. Optional, but required if Exchange is a specified workload.
claims.fix: Replace the call with 'POST /v1.0/solutions/migrations/crossTenantMigrationJobs with displayName <unique batch name>, completeAfterDateTime <date-time>, sourceTenantId <source tenant GUID>, resources [<target user GUIDs>], resourceType Users, workloads [<workload names>], and exchangeSettings {targetDeliveryDomain: <target routing domain>, sourceEndpoint: <target migration endpoint name>} when Exchange is selected'. Mirror it in the table. The endpoint and these keys are documented on the existing Graph create-job URL.

claims.claim: The create-job POST supplies the control for creating, validating and starting orchestrated migration batches.

claims.fix: Change controls[0].governs and its rendered table heading to 'Creating an orchestrated migration batch'. Keep this row limited to job creation; retain the body's existing statement that validation and migration are subsequent operations.

claims.claim: Changes to the migration authorization group's membership can take up to an hour to be processed.
claims.quote: There's up to an hour-long delay between when updates are made to the group containing the authorized users for migration and when our system processes those changes.

claims.claim: The checklist directs administrators to configure or check controls not represented by the four table rows.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'keep OneDrive creation disabled', 'Assign the target-tenant Microsoft 365 Migration Administrator role', 'Monitor batch and per-user status'. Table: create batch, cancel batch, remove user, update date.
claims.fix: The checklist steps for disabling target OneDrive creation, assigning the Migration Administrator role, running validation, monitoring batch and per-user status, retrying failed batches, decommissioning source MailUsers and checking Data Consistency Score have no matching controls-table row. Do not add rows as part of this correction.

claims.claim: The documented migration operates on users an administrator groups into and submits as a batch.
claims.quote: The migration is run by creating a migration job in the form of a batch. Users are grouped together into a batch and submitted together.
